title: Physical-bifolio audit limits independent hand evidence to two reused blocks
statement: The published P-L2-008 metadata table reproduces exactly. The prior same-Currier pair rules independently reproduce 3 strict pairs (5 page sides, 4 folios, 4 physical bifolia) and 14 wider pairs (13 sides, 7 folios, 6 bifolia). Both contain at most two bifolio-disjoint comparisons. Every one of those 3/14 test pairs has both test bifolia represented in its original training fold. Removing their complete physical bifolia leaves only one hand-5 training bifolio in every case. The earlier 10 matched triads occupy six bifolia but at most two disjoint comparisons; two triads contain only two physical bifolia. The separate public evaluation has only one trainable pair, f50v–f66v (G:2/H:1), reusing the physical blocks already present in the earlier evidence. Hand 3 has six eligible panels on Q:2 and no evaluation panel. These designs do not provide three independent replications or three-hand support.
check: For a future hand-specific estimate, hold out all pages and panels of each physical bifolio, identify it by (quire,bifolio), and require at least two distinct training bifolia per candidate hand plus physically disjoint evaluation contrasts. Acquire additional independent hand-5 and hand-3 support before claiming a replicated effect. Retain both transliterations and copying/planted controls when the physical geometry permits fitting. Current sample cannot satisfy these independent-block conditions.
interpretation: This is a metadata/support audit of public practice partitions, not a refutation of any manuscript handwriting attribution. The original folds held folios apart as declared but were not complete-bifolio holdouts. Shared paper blocks can carry location-related lexical structure; no model accuracies were recomputed, and no causal explanation follows. Quire-disjointness is a stronger restriction than bifolio-disjointness. ZL and Takahashi are paired transcriptions of the same manuscript. Bifolio counts use fixed ZL metadata Q and B; metadata may itself require codicological review.

protocol.selection: Paired practice ZL/IT paragraph token counts >=40, agreeing H/B/hand2,3,5 metadata. Prior triple geometry uses >=50 as published.
protocol.unit: Physical bifolio identified by the pair (ZL Q,B), never B alone. All recto/verso/panels share their physical folio.
protocol.comparisons: Reproduce prior metadata table; independently enumerate original pair fold matching and triple matching. Count distinct bifolia, disjoint contrasts, and overlap between scored bifolia and training bifolia. No lexical model or hidden split.
protocol.stop: Retain original match cutoffs. Report absent hand and sparse support before any accuracy claim.

reproduction.usage: From repository root: set PYTHONPATH to repository; python layout.py plan.json > layout-reproduced.json; python audit.py. Standard library only. All outputs refer to public practice split, never hidden split.

"""Metadata-only independent physical-support audit; run from repository root."""
import json, re, hashlib
from collections import Counter
from functools import lru_cache
from itertools import combinations
from pathlib import Path
from vs import corpus, ivtff

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = Path.cwd()

def collect(part, minimum=40):
    editions = {e: corpus.split_pages('practice', e)[part] for e in ('zl','it')}
    it = {p.id:p for p in editions['it']}
    order = list(dict.fromkeys(re.match(r'f\d+',p.id)[0] for p in corpus.pages('zl')))
    rows = []
    for p in editions['zl']:
        q = it.get(p.id)
        if q is None or (p.hand,p.section,p.language)!=(q.hand,q.section,q.language): continue
        lengths = [sum(not ivtff.uncertain(w) for ln in x.lines if ln.unit=='P' for w in ln.words) for x in (p,q)]
        if min(lengths)<minimum or not p.hand or not p.section: continue
        folio = re.match(r'f\d+',p.id)[0]
        rows.append(dict(id=p.id,folio=folio,order=order.index(folio),number=int(folio[1:]),hand=p.hand,
                         section=p.section,language=p.language,lengths=lengths,quire=p.meta.get('Q'),
                         bifolio=p.meta.get('B'),physical=(p.meta.get('Q','?')+':'+p.meta.get('B','?'))))
    return rows

def pack(sets):
    sets = tuple(sorted({tuple(sorted(s)) for s in sets}))
    @lru_cache(None)
    def solve(i,used):
        if i==len(sets): return ()
        best=solve(i+1,used)
        if not set(sets[i]) & set(used):
            candidate=(sets[i],)+solve(i+1,tuple(sorted(set(used)|set(sets[i]))))
            if len(candidate)>len(best): best=candidate
        return best
    return solve(0,())

def support(edges):
    pages={p['id']:p for edge in edges for p in edge}
    return dict(comparisons=len(edges),page_sides=len(pages),folios=len({p['folio'] for p in pages.values()}),
                bifolia=sorted({p['physical'] for p in pages.values()}),
                bifolia_per_comparison=dict(Counter(len({p['physical'] for p in edge}) for edge in edges)),
                max_bifolio_disjoint=len(pack([{p['physical'] for p in edge} for edge in edges])),
                max_quire_disjoint=len(pack([{p['quire'] for p in edge} for edge in edges])),
                witnesses=pack([{p['physical'] for p in edge} for edge in edges]))

def match(a,b,distance,ratio):
    return (a['section']==b['section'] and 0<abs(a['order']-b['order'])<=distance
            and all(max(x,y)/min(x,y)<=ratio for x,y in zip(a['lengths'],b['lengths'])))

def main():
    train,test=collect(0),collect(1)
    eligible=lambda rows:[p for p in rows if p['section']=='H' and p['language']=='B' and p['hand'] in ('2','3','5')]
    tr,ev=eligible(train),eligible(test)
    independent={}
    for name,dist,ratio in [('local',12,1.25),('wide',24,1.5)]:
        raw=[(a,b) for a,b in combinations(ev,2) if a['hand']!=b['hand'] and match(a,b,dist,ratio)]
        details=[]
        for a,b in raw:
            fit=[p for p in tr if p['quire'] not in (a['quire'],b['quire'])]
            counts={h:len({p['folio'] for p in fit if p['hand']==h}) for h in ('2','5')}
            details.append(dict(pages=[a['id'],b['id']],bifolia=[a['physical'],b['physical']],training_folios=counts))
        good=[edge for edge,d in zip(raw,details) if min(d['training_folios'].values())>=2]
        independent[name]=dict(raw=support(raw),trainable=support(good),details=details)
    # Reconstruct the original four-folio modulo-four test folds and both Currier-matched rules.
    prior={}
    for name,dist,ratio in [('strict',12,1.25),('wide',24,1.5)]:
        edges=[]; overlap=[]; clean_training=[]
        for fold in range(4):
            fit=[p for p in train if (p['order']//4)%4!=fold]
            held=[p for p in train if (p['order']//4)%4==fold]
            for a,b in combinations(held,2):
                if a['hand']==b['hand'] or min(sum(p['hand']==h for p in fit) for h in (a['hand'],b['hand']))<2: continue
                if a['language']!=b['language'] or not match(a,b,dist,ratio): continue
                edges.append((a,b))
                shared={a['physical'],b['physical']} & {p['physical'] for p in fit}
                if shared: overlap.append(dict(pages=[a['id'],b['id']],shared=sorted(shared)))
                clean=[p for p in fit if p['physical'] not in (a['physical'],b['physical'])]
                clean_training.append(dict(pages=[a['id'],b['id']],folios_by_hand={h:len({p['folio'] for p in clean if p['hand']==h}) for h in (a['hand'],b['hand'])},bifolia_by_hand={h:sorted({p['physical'] for p in clean if p['hand']==h}) for h in (a['hand'],b['hand'])}))
        prior[name]=dict(support=support(edges),pairs=[[a['id'],b['id']] for a,b in edges],training_overlap=overlap,
                         bifolio_excluded_training=clean_training)
    # Reconstruct prior same-Currier triads under its original numeric-folio 16-leaf blocks.
    tri_docs=collect(0,50); triads=[]; grouped={}
    for a in tri_docs:
        for b in tri_docs:
            for c in tri_docs:
                if len({a['folio'],b['folio'],c['folio']})!=3: continue
                if len({(x['number']-1)//16 for x in (a,b,c)})!=1: continue
                if a['hand']!=b['hand'] or a['hand']==c['hand']: continue
                if len({x['section'] for x in (a,b,c)})!=1 or len({x['language'] for x in (a,b,c)})!=1: continue
                da,dc=abs(a['number']-b['number']),abs(a['number']-c['number'])
                if max(da,dc)>12 or abs(da-dc)>2: continue
                if any(max(x['lengths'][j] for x in (a,b,c))/min(x['lengths'][j] for x in (a,b,c))>1.25 for j in (0,1)): continue
                triads.append((a,b,c));grouped.setdefault(str((a['number']-1)//16),[]).append((a,b,c))
    expected_pairs=json.loads((ROOT/'experiments/K-030-open-1/fleet-sol/step.json').read_text())['practice']['totals']
    pair_counts_match=(prior['strict']['support']['comparisons']==expected_pairs['section and Currier and matched']['pairs']
                       and prior['wide']['support']['comparisons']==expected_pairs['section and Currier and wider match']['pairs'])
    assert pair_counts_match
    assert len(triads)==10
    result=dict(protocol=json.loads((OUT/'plan-independent.json').read_text()),prior_pair_counts_match=pair_counts_match,
                metadata_table_exact_match=json.loads((OUT/'layout-reproduced.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))==json.loads((ROOT/'experiments/P-L2-002/mubadala777/step.json').read_text())['metadata_results'],
                independent_evaluation=ev,independent=independent,prior_pairs=prior,
                prior_triads=dict(support=support(triads),blocks={k:support(v) for k,v in grouped.items()},
                                  rows=[[p['id'] for p in edge] for edge in triads]),
                inventory={h:dict(pages=[p['id'] for p in tr+ev if p['hand']==h],bifolia=sorted({p['physical'] for p in tr+ev if p['hand']==h})) for h in ('2','3','5')},
                hashes={name:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ('data/raw/ZL3b-n.txt','data/raw/IT2a-n.txt')})
    (OUT/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__': main()
